+import json
+import os
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+
+STANDARD_SCHEMA = {
+    "type": "object",
+    "properties": {
+        "merchant_name": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+        "transaction_date": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+        "currency": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+        "total_amount": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
+        "tip_amount": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
+        "tax_amount": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
+        "category": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+        "payment_method": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+        "receipt_id": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+        "confidence": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
+    },
+    "required": [
+        "merchant_name",
+        "transaction_date",
+        "currency",
+        "total_amount",
+        "tip_amount",
+        "tax_amount",
+        "category",
+        "payment_method",
+        "receipt_id",
+        "confidence",
+    ],
+    "additionalProperties": False,
+}
+
+
+def _to_decimal(value: Any) -> Optional[Decimal]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float, Decimal)):
+        return Decimal(str(value))
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        text = value.strip().replace(",", "")
+        if not text:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return Decimal(text)
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            return None
+    return None
+
+
+def _normalize_number(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+    number = _to_decimal(value)
+    return float(number) if number is not None else None
+
+
+def _first_present(data: Dict[str, Any], keys: list[str]) -> Any:
+    for key in keys:
+        if key in data and data[key] not in (None, ""):
+            return data[key]
+    return None
+
+
+def normalize_expense(extracted_fields: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    normalized = {
+        "merchant_name": _first_present(extracted_fields, ["merchant_name", "merchant", "vendor", "store_name"]),
+        "transaction_date": _first_present(extracted_fields, ["transaction_date", "date", "purchase_date"]),
+        "currency": _first_present(extracted_fields, ["currency", "ccy"]),
+        "total_amount": _normalize_number(_first_present(extracted_fields, ["total_amount", "amount", "total", "grand_total"])),
+        "tip_amount": _normalize_number(_first_present(extracted_fields, ["tip_amount", "tip"])),
+        "tax_amount": _normalize_number(_first_present(extracted_fields, ["tax_amount", "tax"])),
+        "category": _first_present(extracted_fields, ["category", "expense_category"]),
+        "payment_method": _first_present(extracted_fields, ["payment_method", "card_type", "payment_type"]),
+        "receipt_id": _first_present(extracted_fields, ["receipt_id", "transaction_id", "id"]),
+        "confidence": _normalize_number(_first_present(extracted_fields, ["confidence", "score"])),
+    }
+    return normalized
+
+
+def normalize_with_openai(extracted_fields: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "Normalize extracted expense fields into the requested JSON schema exactly.",
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": json.dumps(extracted_fields),
+            },
+        ],
+        text={
+            "format": {
+                "type": "json_schema",
+                "name": "expense_normalization",
+                "schema": STANDARD_SCHEMA,
+                "strict": True,
+            }
+        },
+    )
+    return json.loads(response.output_text)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    payload = json.loads(sys.stdin.read() or "{}")
+    result = normalize_with_openai(payload) if os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY") else normalize_expense(payload)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _encode_input(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(data).decode("utf-8")
+
+
+def extract_receipt_fields(image_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        image_bytes = f.read()
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_text",
+                        "text": "Extract merchant, tax, total, and items from this receipt. Return strict JSON with keys merchant (string or null), tax (number or null), total (number or null), and items (array of objects with name, quantity, and price).",
+                    },
+                    {
+                        "type": "input_image",
+                        "image_url": f"data:image/png;base64,{_encode_input(image_bytes)}",
+                    },
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "text": {"format": {"type": "json_object"}},
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    output_text: Optional[str] = None
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                output_text = content.get("text")
+                if output_text:
+                    break
+        if output_text:
+            break
+
+    if not output_text:
+        raise ValueError("No structured response content returned by OpenAI API")
+
+    return json.loads(output_text)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: python extract_receipt_fields.py <receipt_image_path>")
+    result = extract_receipt_fields(sys.argv[1])
+    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
